failure_observed: The study never exercised the skill as designed: one agent role-played CORPUS, AUTHOR and REVIEW; every ASK/STOP was auto-resolved as an 'accepted risk' (Phase 9 writers logged 10-11 each, some resolving factual questions such as which dataset count to trust); G4 (external review addressed) and G5 were never run; and gate 'passed' values were free text (e.g. 'ALL SEVEN AUDITS COMPLETE AND PASS ...'). The skill's own review_agent.md still compressed the 12 reconstruction questions into one line, the defect D-13 had found in the harness.

metrics.e2e_run: ASMOS, 4 separate role agents: 0 validator errors, 0 role violations, 0 agent-answered checkpoints, 9/9 blocked claims absent from the paper, 19/19 blocking review items dispositioned (18 fixed, 1 deferred to checkpoint Q-005), G4 passed, G5 failed by design on 17 author-only markers; 5 tool defects found and fixed (T-045, T-047..T-050). See evaluation/stage4_e2e/E2E_REPORT.md

components.summary: Role separation (tools/workflow_guard.py): per-role write permissions, append-only provenance ledger with hashes, ROLE_VIOLATION / UNATTRIBUTED_CHANGE; adapter role notes.

Human checkpoints: ask/answer/status CLI (answers only by a named person); claims blocked by an open question must be BLOCKED (CHECKPOINT_BYPASSED); accepted risks typed workflow|factual, factual is an error (ACCEPTED_RISK_FACTUAL).

Executable G4 (tools/g4_check.py): review exists for the exact draft (packet manifest now records source draft hash), every blocking finding and inference issue has a disposition, 'fixed' implies a changed draft, reviewer isolation log; state.json G4 needs a fresh report.

Gate runner (tools/run_workflow.py): runs G1, G3, V*, G4, G5 as separate processes, writes back only validator-confirmed statuses, appends each command with exit code, report hash and tool SHA-256 to RUN_LOG.jsonl.
review_agent.md restates the 12 reconstruction questions verbatim with a do-not-substitute instruction (Part B(a), D-13).

Defects found by the Stage 4 e2e run and fixed mid-run (evaluation/stage4_e2e/MIDRUN_TOOL_CHANGES.jsonl): ledger paths outside .rcs (final manuscript) crashed record(); review packets omitted linked figures (unhashed); S1/S2 vs BLOCKED-claim-used contradiction forced a placeholder claim (now S1/S2-author-statement-withheld WARN); line charts drew the value axis horizontally (renderer fixed, renderer-independent V3_AXIS_ENCODING added, real faulty figure as fixture). Also: the gate runner ran G1 before G3/V reports were refreshed (G1 now runs after them).

change.summary: All checks opt in per project (ledger present, checkpoints present, guardrail v0.3), so legacy projects keep their behaviour.

expected_improvement: Tool/process level: role boundaries, human checkpoints and review uptake become verifiable instead of asserted; a run's gate history is reproducible from RUN_LOG.jsonl. Reader level: not claimed.
possible_regressions: Bookkeeping cost: every role must record its writes; forgetting produces UNATTRIBUTED_CHANGE warnings.
Unattended runs now stop short of stating facts that need a human answer; papers may carry more [ASK AUTHOR]-blocked gaps than before (by design).
The REVIEW role cannot run tools, so an orchestrator records its ledger entries; the ledger attests which role produced the files, not which process wrote the bytes.
G4's 'fixed' check is structural (location named, draft changed); whether a fix actually resolves the finding still needs the next review round.
